result:
The proposed answer of 6 is most likely wrong. This rests on my recollection of the literature, not on a derivation or a check of the construction.

I recall the known result as a(3,n) = 4 for n ≥ 18, from work on the minimum number of longest paths in connected graphs with minimum degree 3.

The proposed solution gives no real proof. Its "product of Hamiltonian paths from two blocks at a cut vertex" argument is vague and does not match how longest paths are counted in such constructions. It also asserts that the bound is sharp without showing a graph that attains 6.

VERDICT: REJECT
